flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmseserviceui pages/Furnish/Form/{HDParticulars,Particulars}.ts, utils/map/MapFurnish.ts. ocmseserviceapi workflows/furnish/{FurnishSubmissionController,FurnishRequestValidator,FurnishSubmissionServiceImpl}. ocmsadminprivateapi furnish_processing/helpers/FurnishApprovalHelper (checkFinPassportIdType). No code for the 'continue despite expired work pass' decision.
note: The story is not in any flow deck; sheet status is 'Built - Ready for User Acceptance', demo_remark 'Internet PII encryption - cannot fetch offender particulars'. The story depends on OCMS42.18 (the decision after the expiry message), which does not exist in code, so there is no dedicated 'continue even though the work pass expired' path. What exists is the generic particulars form, always fillable for ID type FIN and saved through the normal submit; FIN goes to manual review. The fit is Sebagian because it is a generic mechanism, not the path the story names. Saving and reading back the encrypted PII data: cannot verify from repo (the demo remark says offender particulars cannot be fetched).
recommendation: Do not claim in full. The generic particulars form and saving exist, but the 'continue despite expired work pass' decision does not exist because it depends on OCMS42.18.

steps.step: The user's decision to continue the submission for an FIN with an expired work pass is recorded
steps.detail: There is no field, state or payload for a 'continue even though the work pass expired' decision: MapFurnish.ts:43-56 and the submission DTO do not contain such a flag, and there is no decision stage before the form (see OCMS42.18, the expiry message does not exist). The hirer/driver form can be filled directly without any decision.

steps.step: The owner/hirer can still fill in the driver's (FIN) particulars after that decision
steps.detail: The driver particulars form accepts ID type FIN with no condition on work pass status (HDParticulars.ts:205-260, option.ts:14-30), so the user can always fill it in. This is a generic mechanism, not a continuation of the story's decision (the decision does not exist), so it is Sebagian at best.

POST /v1/furnishapplication validates and then saves every notice as Pending in eocms_furnish_application (FurnishSubmissionController.java:66-200, FurnishSubmissionServiceImpl.java:160-218). For FIN, the approval cron puts it into manual review (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:296-310). This saving is generic for all ID types, not specific to an expired FIN. Demo_remark 'Internet PII encryption - cannot fetch offender particulars': PII column encryption and reading it back cannot verify from repo. Tickets OCMS-DF-2026-110/-143/-175 (generic submit error, Closed) do not change the fit.
